answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Work waits on the violet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the sonnet of the next round. The orchard of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, expired if not renewed by fresh work, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
